name: IS<Infinite Stratos>2 Love and Purge
original_name: IS＜インフィニット・ストラトス＞2 ラブ アンド パージ
source:
Set several days after the "World Purge" chapter, Infinite Stratos 2 has players developing relationships with the IS heroines as Ichika Orimura. "Braveheart Points" signify Ichika's manhood, and will fluctuate depending on choices made during conversations, with endings changing as a result of the final value.

In addition to chatting it up, Ichika can give the heroines a massage to deepen their bonds and increase Braveheart Points. Techniques involve tapping and rubbing properly, though, so you can mess up and fail, losing points as a result.

[from [url=https://www.crunchyroll.com/es/anime-news/2015/02/16-1/infinite-stratos-2-love-and-purge-confirmed-as-ps-vita-game]Crunchyroll[/url]]
translation:
故事發生在「世界清除篇」之後數日。《IS〈Infinite Stratos〉2》讓玩家以織斑一夏的身分，與各位IS女主角發展關係。「勇者之心點數」代表一夏的男子氣概，會根據對話中的選擇上下變化，最終數值也會改變結局。

除了聊天，一夏還可以為女主角按摩，以加深彼此羈絆並提高勇者之心點數。不過，按摩需要正確地敲擊和揉捏，操作失誤就會失敗並損失點數。

［來源：[url=https://www.crunchyroll.com/es/anime-news/2015/02/16-1/infinite-stratos-2-love-and-purge-confirmed-as-ps-vita-game]Crunchyroll[/url]］
